title: pySLAM fork for the GS-AgriField baseline benchmark
description: Version of pySLAM used for the baseline benchmark of the GS-AgriField dataset: upstream pySLAM (commit b747a10) with the changes used for the benchmark, and the benchmark scripts, configurations and reference results in configs/gs_agrifield_benchmark/. pySLAM is developed by Luigi Freda (https://github.com/luigifreda/pyslam).
